# Psalm 105 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Give-thanks to-YHWH, call on-his-name; make-known among-the-peoples his-deeds.

**2** Sing to-him, sing-praises to-him; meditate on-all his-wonders.

**3** Boast in-name-of his-holiness; let-rejoice the-heart-of seekers-of YHWH.

**4** Seek YHWH and-his-strength; seek his-face continually.

**5** Remember his-wonders which he-has-done, his-signs and-judgments-of his-mouth,

**6** O-seed-of Abraham his-servant, sons-of Jacob his-chosen-ones.

**7** He YHWH our-God; in-all the-earth his-judgments.

**8** He-remembers to-forever his-covenant, the-word he-commanded to-a-thousand generations,

**9** Which he-made with-Abraham, and-his-oath to-Isaac,

**10** And-he-confirmed-it to-Jacob as-a-statute, to-Israel a-covenant everlasting,

**11** Saying, 'To-you I-will-give the-land-of Canaan, the-portion-of your-inheritance.'

**12** When-they-were men-of number few, very-few and-sojourners in-it,

**13** And-they-wandered from-nation to nation, from-kingdom to people another,

**14** Not he-allowed man to-oppress-them, and-he-rebuked on-their-account kings:

**15** 'Do-not touch my-anointed-ones, and-to-my-prophets do-no harm.'

**16** And-he-called a-famine on the-land; every staff-of bread he-broke.

**17** He-sent before-them a-man; as-a-slave was-sold Joseph.

**18** They-afflicted with-fetters his-foot; iron came-upon his-soul,

**19** Until the-time his-word came; the-saying-of YHWH refined-him.

**20** He-sent a-king and-he-released-him, ruler-of peoples and-he-set-him-free.

**21** He-made-him lord-of his-house, and-ruler-of all his-possessions,

**22** To-bind his-princes at-his-will, and-his-elders he-would-teach-wisdom.

**23** And-came Israel to-Egypt, and-Jacob sojourned in-land-of Ham.

**24** And-he-made-fruitful his-people greatly, and-he-made-them-stronger than-their-adversaries.

**25** He-turned their-heart to-hate his-people, to-deal-craftily with-his-servants.

**26** He-sent Moses his-servant, Aaron whom he-had-chosen.

**27** They-set among-them words-of his-signs, and-wonders in-land-of Ham.

**28** He-sent darkness and-he-made-it-dark; and-not they-rebelled-against his-words.

**29** He-turned their-waters to-blood, and-he-killed their-fish.

**30** Swarmed their-land frogs, in-chambers-of their-kings.

**31** He-spoke and-came swarms-of-flies, gnats in-all their-territory.

**32** He-gave their-rain hail, fire-of-flames in-their-land.

**33** And-he-struck their-vine and-their-fig-tree, and-he-broke the-trees-of their-territory.

**34** He-spoke and-came the-locust, and-the-young-locust and-no number,

**35** And-it-ate all vegetation in-their-land, and-it-ate the-fruit-of their-ground.

**36** And-he-struck all firstborn in-their-land, the-firstfruits-of all their-vigor.

**37** And-he-brought-them-out with-silver and-gold, and-there-was-no among-his-tribes one-stumbling.

**38** Was-glad Egypt at-their-going, for had-fallen their-dread upon-them.

**39** He-spread a-cloud for-a-covering, and-fire to-light-up the-night.

**40** They-asked and-he-brought quail, and-bread-of heaven he-satisfied-them.

**41** He-opened a-rock and-flowed waters; they-went in-the-dry-places a-river.

**42** For he-remembered his-holy word, Abraham his-servant.

**43** And-he-brought-out his-people with-joy, with-singing his-chosen-ones.

**44** And-he-gave to-them the-lands-of nations, and-labor-of peoples they-inherited,

**45** So-that they-might-keep his-statutes, and-his-laws they-might-observe. Praise Yah!

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **105:8-11**: The Abrahamic covenant traced through three patriarchs: Abraham (made), Isaac (oath), Jacob (statute) — progressive confirmation.

- **105:19**: 'The-saying-of YHWH refined-him' (tsarefathu) — Joseph's imprisonment was a refining process; testing as divine pedagogy.

— EMET
